planted_defects.summary: The report's profile section is Barnum material — 'natural connector', 'high standards', 'at your best making a difference' fit nearly anyone
The report claims detail and process work drain Elaine; her reviews praise exactly that work as her signature strength, and her own intake answers say she enjoys it
'Expect offers within three to six months' of a UX bootcamp ignores the crowded entry-level UX market and her complete absence of design record — no base rate, no reason she beats it
The report never engages with money at all, despite her intake stating the redundancy must last and she needs income by spring; the bootcamp fee alone cuts her ~12-month runway to ~8 months
Paths two (four days a week on client sites in London/Manchester) and three ('aim national, on the road') violate her stated twice-weekly care for her mother and no-nights-away constraint
The report ends with 'no wrong choice, choose from the heart' — it ranks nothing and recommends nothing, handing the paid-for decision back to her
Every 'next step' costs money or commits her (deposit, certification booking, company registration) before anything has been tested cheaply
